_provenance.server: Google Drive remote MCP server (official, Google-hosted)
_provenance.method: DOCUMENTED ONLY - transcribed from developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/mcp and its per-tool pages. NOT captured from a live tools/list: the server requires OAuth 2.0 and Google Workspace Developer Preview Program membership, which this project does not have.
_provenance.required_markers: Only fields the docs mark 'Required' are listed in 'required'. search_files.query is not explicitly marked required in the docs, so it is not listed.
notes: No tool deletes, trashes, moves or updates a file; files created by create_file cannot be rolled back through MCP.
search_files uses its own query syntax ('query_term operator values'), e.g. title = 'x' and parentId = 'y'; strings are single-quoted and embedded quotes escaped as \'.
read_file_content: 'don't make assumptions about the particular format of the text returned'.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for Drive files using a structured query (syntax: `query_term operator values`).

pageSize.description: The maximum number of files to return in each page.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

tools.name: read_file_content
tools.description: fetch a natural language representation of a Drive file, and optionally, its comments.

fileId.description: Required. The ID of the file to retrieve.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: create or upload a File to Google Drive.

mimeType.description: DEPRECATED. DO NOT USE!! Set content_mime_type instead.

contentMimeType.description: Required when any type of content is provided.

parentId.description: The parent id of the file.

tools.name: get_file_metadata
tools.description: find general metadata about a user's Drive file.

fileId.description: Required. The ID of the file to retrieve.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.
